description: DRY RUN — never pays, never signs, never touches the keychain. Fetches a URL once; if the server answers 402 with an x402 challenge, returns the price, network, asset, recipient, and any Self.xyz requirements so you can decide whether to pay before calling buy_curl. Run this before the first paid call to an endpoint: buy_curl settles without a quote, and a settled payment is irreversible.

account.description: buy account name, used to pick the preferred network. If omitted, uses the configured default account.

body.description: Request body (raw string), same as buy_curl. Required by endpoints that validate input before pricing: quoting POST /google/vm without its JSON body returns 400, not the 402 challenge you are asking about.

headers.description: Extra request headers as a key/value map

sandbox.description: If true, prefer the celo-sepolia requirement. Otherwise uses the account network.

name: buy_pay_quote
title: Quote an x402 price (dry run)
